provenanceStatus: committed-source snapshot; finite ray evidence, separate visual approval required

method.scope: All exterior route/city/town maps plus source forest gate maps 117/147. Bank-1 solid bounds at least 2×2×2 tiles, plus thin League gates. All rejected candidates retain bounds and placement transforms.

broadphase.narrowphase: Original triangle order, exact Three intersection, rayNear, UV/alpha and full diagnostic fallback are unchanged. Padding only admits extra broadphase candidates.

method.bodySeeds: 3×3 footprint grid, three wall-relative heights, under source roof, at least three horizontal blockers both near the floor and at each seed height; through-buildings allow two. Pagodas9/54 and raised shrine71 use measured native chamber/story cores. Gates35/36/246/247 use measured central rooms behind native cards and any event-derived rear card. Tower262 retains original roof absence within proven body cores; source-body profiles168/265/266 preserve omitted-side deficits. Native roof ornament/veranda/entry-alcove exclusions retain actual source-hit witnesses. Lighthouse/radio/silo elevations add proven shaft/lantern cores. Replaced generic grids, rejection counts and explicit source ranges remain recorded.
method.usedGeometry: Visible used-index triangles, skinned getVertexPosition plus full world transforms; Body bounds exclude shadow/foliage materials. Surface intersections are two-sided for physical enclosure; the separate gallery must review outward visibility and material sides. Rays include visible shadow-named door cards with decoded alpha, while omitting foliage and materials below 0.5 opacity. Lighthouse110 projected hikari searchlights with native U0.02..<0.15 are omitted and counted separately; actual glazing U>0.19 remains. Actual placed DOOR attachments and verified native co-located assemblies remain separate recorded blockers.
method.alpha: Embedded 8-bit RGBA PNG decoded losslessly. MASK/BLEND intersections interpolate UV barycentrically and use texture wrap/flipY, native alphaTest or 0.5 blend-opacity threshold. Native OPAQUE remains opaque regardless of image alpha.
method.exceptions: Event corridors have a 2.25-tile height bound; measured facade gaps extend only to a proven native header. Authored h_in recesses use their native rectangle and a matching front-facing functional entrance. Physical source apertures181/264/265/317 use guarded native canopy/porch/jamb extents; Ruins158/159/161/162 physical entrances use source-hashed literal upper/lower jamb and lintel geometry without asserting a functional warp;265 uses a nonplanar virtual probe bounded by source jamb/header vertices, not building geometry;181 remains distinct from active warp metadata.218/240/295 reject only source-card/floor-proven front exterior alcoves.87 additionally verifies its inclined native curtain aperture and exact nonplanar backplate hit.295 separately labels its event-derived repaired northern passage; functional warp is not asserted. No downward-floor assertion. Open-air props and named gates retain raw rays and require source review.
method.sourceCategoryRegistry: reviews/building-category-triage.json readOnlySourceClassifications; exact native asset SHA guarded per placement
limitations: No automatic visual approval or stylistic/material validation.

numericalEdgeRays preserve exact-intersection misses and optional nearby opaque triangle witnesses, including strict mode; diagnostic witnesses do not change strict blocked/unexpected counts and are not strict seals.
Unclassified structures, native gate passages and missing confident cores require manual classification.
Interior seeds are conservative and cannot prove every decorative attachment is closed.

builderPerformance.status: measured single synchronous call per inventoried bank-one placement
builderPerformance.scope: Only closeBuildingExterior (or explicit partial helpers), including generic and family construction. Excludes clone, asset load/shared repair, world terrain/footings, ray tests and metric collection. Node wall-clock timings under current process/CPU contention are not browser frame-time measurements.
